meta.name: research-domain
meta.description: Research domain context, users, jobs-to-be-done, constraints, terminology, workflows, risks, and decision pressure before requirements or architecture. Use when creating a new product, entering an unfamiliar domain, validating product assumptions, preparing `05-domain-research.md`, or deciding what the system must respect before design or implementation begins.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调研领域背景,摸清用户与风险,让设计有据可依
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在做产品或设计前先把领域弄明白。
copy.tagline_en: Research your domain to understand users and risks before design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to understand a new domain before starting design work.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在动手前先做领域调研:从资料里收集事实,梳理用户、工作流、术语和约束,把风险写成可验证的问题,并输出领域摘要、用户地图、术语表及风险清单,只把相关发现传给后续。
howto.when: 当你创建新产品、进入陌生领域或准备 `05-domain-research.md` 时触发;也用于验证产品假设、梳理设计前约束等场景。

say.text: 我要开发一款老年人用药提醒产品,先做用户和风险调研。
say.note: Claude会输出领域摘要、用户地图与风险清单。

say.text: 准备进入光伏电站运维领域,帮我整理术语和约束。
say.note: 生成术语表和外部约束清单。

say.text: 帮我按 `05-domain-research.md` 结构做一次领域调研。
say.note: 产出结构化领域研究文档。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude researches first: collects facts, maps users/workflows, lists terms/constraints, writes risks as testable questions, and outputs a domain summary, user map, glossary, and risk list—passing only relevant findings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you create a new product, enter an unfamiliar domain, or prepare `05-domain-research.md`; also for validating product assumptions and scoping design-time constraints.

say_en.text: I'm building a medication reminder for seniors. Research users and risks first.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a domain summary, user map, and risk list.

say_en.text: I'm entering PV plant O&M. Help me list terminology and constraints.
say_en.note: Produces a glossary and external constraint list.

say_en.text: Run domain research following the `05-domain-research.md` structure.
say_en.note: Produces a structured domain research document.
